decisions.statement: A subtype narrows every subtype its parent narrows.
The parent a subtype names is read off the index.
A parent is named as an address.
The slug is the part of that address past the page type.
A subtype naming no parent narrows nothing above itself.
A subtype the index files no page for narrows nothing above itself.
A chain of parents coming back on itself is walked once.

definition: whether one change target subtype narrows another
